From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Geo transition: merit offset and equity clarification for senior SRE promotion

Hi team,

Quick summary: Samir Patel (SRE, IC5) is being promoted to Senior SRE (IC6) effective 2027-05-01. He recently completed an internal transfer from our US office to Dublin (final move completed 2027-03-28). During the transfer, his compensation banding and local market benchmarks shifted; the normal merit slot for his band is $8k, equity refresh guideline is 0.01–0.02% for IC6.

Request / ask: I’m proposing an exception to the standard merit cap for Samir because:
- We’re competing with local Dublin market hires (strong retention risk).
- He’s taking on cross-region pager rotations that materially expand scope.
- The transfer overlap created a payroll cycle timing issue — he missed the April merit run; we need a one-time offset payment and equity refresh to align with the promotion and retention plan.

Proposed package (manager recommendation):
- One-time merit top-up: $15,000 (one-time)
- Equity refresh: 0.03% (grant via refresh, subject to legal/vesting standard)
- Effective date: 2027-05-01

I attached the promotion summary, the comp run showing banding, and my manager justification. If this goes above any approval thresholds, pls advise next steps. I’ve cc’d Aditya for finance routing.

Files: [promotion_summary_MH_20270418.pdf] [comp_run_geo_offsets.xlsx] [mgr_justification_marissa.txt]

Short timeline: we need an approval decision by EOD 2027-04-19 to hit the May 1 effective date and avoid a delayed equity grant window.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geo transition: merit offset and equity clarification for senior SRE promotion

Thanks for the write-up, Marissa — good context. A few immediate questions before comp can route to approvals: 

1) Budget code: what cost center should this one-time payment charge? Please provide the GL and headcount tag so Finance can validate.
2) Equity cap: 0.03% is above the typical refresh guideline for IC6; please confirm manager justification detailing exceptional scope (examples, customer-impact projects, and on-call escalations).
3) Tax/withholding: because Samir completed a transfer to Ireland in March, we need confirmation from Payroll / Global Mobility that the $15k gross treatment is correct and that equity grant will follow Irish withholding rules. I cc’d Aditya for Finance/PAY.
4) Approvals: if the aggregate comp (one-time + equity) exceeds the Compensation Committee threshold of $50k equivalent, we’ll need explicit sign-off from LA leadership. The proposed values look under that threshold in cash but might exceed on valuation if we apply a present-value on equity; please confirm.

If you can return the requested GL code and a one-paragraph expansion of the exceptional work (bulletized) I’ll run this to Rishi and the Comp Committee for a decision.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geo transition: merit offset and equity clarification for senior SRE promotion

Appreciate the details. Quick read: I support an exceptional one-time cash top-up to preserve retention while the equity paperwork is sorted through legal. Two notes: 

- Cash: $15k one-time is acceptable from my side if the headcount/GL tags are provided and Finance confirms affordability for the org this quarter. If Finance flags constraints, please prepare a fallback: $8k cash + $7k retention bonus paid across two months.
- Equity: 0.03% is higher than our normal IC6 median; I’m willing to greenlight 0.02% immediately. Any >0.02% must go to the Compensation Committee (LA leadership). If legal/Payroll confirm the move to Ireland created any equity recapture complications, we should defer the final equity grant until those are resolved.

Action items for Marissa:
1) Confirm GL/cost center and provide the bulletized exceptional scope (2–3 bullets).
2) If you want the full 0.03%, advise and I’ll escalate to the Comp Committee this afternoon.

I’ll hold off on formal approval until Mina confirms payroll tax routing and Aditya confirms the GL.

-Rishi
SVP, Total Rewards

On Apr 18, 2027, at 8:12 AM, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary: Samir Patel (SRE, IC5) is being promoted to Senior SRE (IC6) effective 2027-05-01....

Thanks for the thread and attachments — I reviewed the promotion packet and Marissa’s justification. Given the cross-region move, scope increase, and market pressures in Dublin, I approve the following as an exception: 

- One-time merit top-up: $12,000 (reduced from the requested $15k to keep within org cash targets)
- Equity refresh: 0.02% (Comp Committee greenlight not required)
- Charge to GL: ENG-SRE-EU-2027 (please confirm in the ticket)

Mina/Aditya: please coordinate tax treatment and run the payroll adjustment for the May pay period if possible. Legal to prepare the equity grant paperwork with Ireland withholding in mind. Marissa: communicate to Samir that he will receive the adjusted cash and the equity grant vests on the standard schedule; let me know if you need a DocuSign link for the grant.

Closing note: I prefer the smaller cash number vs. the original ask because it keeps discretionary spend within our Q2 hiring/operational cadence while still materially improving retention.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
